entry_points.text: Maple suite entry runs one benchmark or ordered functional groups on fresh trees, covering fork, iteration, navigation, gaps, spanning, fuzz and cyclic allocation, then syncs and succeeds only when run equals passed.

Memcat, meminit and hello entries allocate and verify concatenation, zeroing and constructor patterns across pages, heap, slab and RCU, greeting on load and releasing all state before returning status.
Objagg module entry runs nodelta then delta then hints suites in order, stopping at first failure; exit releases nothing.

hazards.text: Maple duplication OOM logs and halts; validation precedes destroy and any position, range, value or status mismatch aborts the boot check; synthetic allocation identity must be restored after stress loops.

Skip beyond size warns and risks underflow; out-of-range keys alias slot zero; post-free inspection is safe only under read-side protection for RCU caches; allocation failures unwind without dereference with bounded scans; suites return one invalid status on any failure; every object and stats or hints snapshot must be released with unwind skipping verification and buffer compare only when creation was expected.

Range-alloc plus external-lock flags select locked trees versus range-only mode; kernel alloc mode, max-key unbounded limit, depth-one nesting order, width-selected multilevel indices and sentinel-driven non-kernel test mode control walks and duplication.

invariants.text: Duplication preserves order for in-place rewrite; walks visit increasing keys with exact windows; successor follows bounds including split remainders; gaps report absence; end oversteps allow step-back; gap search picks lowest or highest fitting hole else busy or invalid; cyclic allocation is consecutive with reuse then failure; bulk stride plus clear stresses spanning; each group uses a fresh tree and benchmark bypasses functional suite.

Concat preserves order with summed length, cancelling payloads and intact markers; fresh pages, heap and vmalloc must read zero via soil, release and realloc check; slab is zeroed unless RCU or no-zero requested, constructor writes its pattern at start and never pairs with zeroing; soiling writes word pattern plus byte tail; nonzero count is the oracle; suites log pass or fail totals with module prefix across slab sizes, heap powers of two, page orders, RCU reuse bound and bulk zeroing.

Same key returns one handle with refcount; index is identity below capacity else warns and folds to zero; ops are get and put with unchanged, inc or dec expectations built by snapshot helpers; nodelta table refuses deltas while delta table delegates; get and put check tally moves, key and content; empty has zero entries and populated has one per key with two users each; suites run create, reuse and release passes; counter checks reject wrong direction; key resolves from root plus delta; stats need exact length and per-entry match with neighbour search; delta steps verify with compensating unwind; hints replay a fixed sequence and compare baseline versus greedy snapshots on two aggregators.

locks.text: Externally locked trees hold caller write semaphores across populate, duplicate and teardown with nested subclass ordering the second tree; cursor walks hold the cursor lock plus optional read-side section; one cyclic batch holds the tree lock across many allocations.
Read-side section protects copy, free and inspect of RCU slab objects; a barrier syncs callbacks before final pass accounting.

state_machines.text: Cursor moves among start, root, active, paused, none, overflow and underflow via walks, scans, finds and next or prev; pause preserves for resume, widening limits recovers from over or underflow, stores from a positioned cursor affect successors, ending in destroy.

Tree suite branches to one benchmark or an ordered functional chain then sync, report and terminal status; concat moves alloc, populate, validate and release to pass or fail; slab cycles alloc, validate, soil and release with an RCU copy, free and check variant; objagg refs go untracked to shared to untracked with roots persisting while deltas reference them until empty.

structs.text: Cursor exposes start and end window, node handle, tree link, status and slot offset; tests assign windows directly and compare node identity for boundary crossing.

Memcat record pairs signed payload with marker; objagg key, world, root and delta hold ids, counters, handles and buffers; INPUT_MAX 128, EXPECT 254, MAGIC 0xf00ff00f, GARBAGE_INT 0x09A7BA9E, GARBAGE_BYTE 0x9E, CTOR pattern 0x41414141 over int size, BULK_SIZE 100, NUM_KEYS 32, BUF_LEN 128, MAX_KEY_ID_DIFF 5.

Pool accounting uses alloc and free tallies plus hit and miss counters; runtime joins start semaphore, two completions, two isolated thread atomics, allocator and object stats and duration; config adds mode, sizes, bulk depths, timing and name; objagg snapshots pair stats with root flag and key id in a counted fixed array; steps bind key, action and expected moves; hints case holds a replay sequence with baseline and optimized snapshots; OT_NR_MAX_BULK is 16.
